# Zen Garden (`sandGarden`)

A little rake cart slowly re-rakes a dry garden of pale gravel, stones and moss: lines, waves and ripples.

- Type: scene (draws its own image; put it first)
- Reacts to: sun, location
- Cost: medium (~4.2 ms/frame at 5K on a Pro GPU)
- Built-in styles: Zen Garden, Black Sand

## Params

| key | label | kind | range / options | default |

| `speed` | Speed | slider | 0 … 3 | 1 |
| `pattern` | Pattern | menu | 0 Surprise · 1 Lines · 2 Waves · 3 Ripples | 0 (Surprise) |
| `groove` | Rake Width | slider | 0.6 … 1.6 | 1 |
| `framing` | Framing | menu | 0 Fill · 1 Garden | 0 (Fill) |
| `relief` | Relief | slider | 0 … 1 | 0.6 |
| `angle` | Light Angle | slider | 0 … 360 | 215 |
| `height` | Light Height | slider | 8 … 60 | 26 |
| `live` | Follow the Sun | toggle | 0 / 1 | off |
